name: log file switch等待诊断
description: log file switch 等待分两种：checkpoint incomplete（上个日志的 checkpoint 未完成）和 archiving needed（上个日志未归档完成）。两者都表示 Redo Log 配置不足以支撑当前的写入负载。详细诊断和解决方案参考 ORA_163 Redo Log 切换优化。

conditions.desc: log file switch 等待占 DB Time > 1%

skip_when.desc: log file switch 等待极少

root_causes.name: Redo Log 过小
root_causes.desc: 日志组大小不足，频繁切换导致 checkpoint 来不及完成。需要增大到 1-4GB。

root_causes.name: 日志组不够多
root_causes.desc: 日志组太少，所有组都处于 ACTIVE 状态。增加到 5-7 组。

root_causes.name: 归档目的地 IO 慢
root_causes.desc: 归档写入慢阻塞日志切换。优化归档 IO。

root_causes.name: DBWR 写入慢
root_causes.desc: DBWR 无法及时完成 checkpoint 的脏块写入。

step1_switch_waits.desc: 检查 log file switch 等待详情
step1_switch_waits.sql: SELECT event, total_waits, ROUND(time_waited_micro/GREATEST(total_waits,1)/1000, 2) avg_ms, ROUND(time_waited_micro/1e6) total_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE event LIKE 'log file switch%'

step2_log_config.sql: SELECT group#, bytes/1024/1024 size_mb, members, status FROM v$log ORDER BY group#

step3_switch_frequency.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(first_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24') hr, COUNT(*) switches FROM v$log_history WHERE first_time > SYSDATE - 1 GROUP BY TO_CHAR(first_time,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24') ORDER BY hr DESC FETCH FIRST 24 ROWS ONLY
